story_sequence.text: When a user explicitly supplies a Beacon version, implement resolves `docs/beacon/<version>/execution/` materials before code edit or commit.
Implement reads branch governance, git workflow, and deterministic implementation contract materials when present.
Implement validates the target service's canonical branch and canonical worktree before allowing mutation.
`expected_branch=per-service` resolves through the service branch/worktree map and never passes as a literal branch.
Branch/worktree mismatch blocks code edit, commit, push, UAT merge, and delivery.
`origin/master` ancestry validation remains required but cannot by itself satisfy implement preflight.
A Rolo v2.0.0 scenario with `marketing_sys` and `marketing_primary_fe` on `feature/v1.3.5-truth-engine-cutover` blocks and recommends `feature/v2.0.0-all` worktrees.
Blocked output includes reason codes and expected canonical branch/worktree recommendations.
